title: Trump Administration Unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' for Federal AI Governance
detail: The Trump administration launched a new 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee federal AI policy, marking a major structural step in the administration's approach to artificial intelligence governance across federal agencies.

media.caption: Trump administration creates Super Intelligence Force to oversee federal AI policy

title: Trump Travels to Nebraska to Campaign Ahead of Midterm Elections
detail: President Trump traveled to Nebraska to campaign ahead of the midterm elections, part of ongoing Republican efforts to shore up their position in competitive districts.
